name: agent-cowork-ui
description: Agent Cowork desktop UI (React + Vite + TS). Builds to ../ui-dist for the Tauri shell.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && vitest run --config vite.config.ts
